tools.description:
Free, unauthenticated dataset catalog.

Describes every table this service sells, its fields, current pricing,
and freshness. Read this before paying for anything.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: lookup_carrier, search_carriers, get_safety_history, check_roster_changes, get_carrier_selection_record · Private data: lookup_carrier, search_carriers, get_safety_history, check_carrier_identity, check_address_consistency, confirm_identity_link, check_applicant_against_roster, find_carrier_by_mc, check_roster_changes, get_carrier_selection_record, get_inspection_crash_summary, check_broker_authority · Public sink: lookup_carrier, search_carriers, get_safety_history, confirm_identity_link, check_roster_changes, get_carrier_selection_record, get_inspection_crash_summary.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: lookup_carrier, search_carriers, get_safety_history, check_roster_changes, get_carrier_selection_record · Private data: lookup_carrier, search_carriers, get_safety_history, check_carrier_identity, check_address_consistency, confirm_identity_link, check_applicant_against_roster, find_carrier_by_mc, check_roster_changes, get_carrier_selection_record, get_inspection_crash_summary, check_broker_authority · Public sink: lookup_carrier, search_carriers, get_safety_history, confirm_identity_link, check_roster_changes, get_carrier_selection_record, get_inspection_crash_summary

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

detail: Tool "lookup_carrier" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
